verdict.rationale: Pulley's fundraising-modeling page says users can 'run models for complex pre-financing, post-financing, or exit scenarios' and 'explore the full spectrum of possible scenarios,' so some exit modeling exists. Nothing in the evidence describes a waterfall output, a per-class or per-stakeholder breakdown, or how preferences and participation are handled. Missing for 10: documented waterfall output, proceeds per share class and per stakeholder, varying exit values, handling of liquidation preferences and participation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
